names.note: Read out of saint.gr's line for 2 Ιουνίου, «Άγιος Δημήτριος από τη Φιλαδέλφεια Νεομάρτυρας», with the rank word left off.

death.note: saint.gr's head line reads «Αγιος Δημητριος Απο Τη Φιλαδελφεια Νεομαρτυρας (; - 1657)» and the life says he gave up his spirit «την 2α Ιουνίου 1657 μ.Χ.» The page gives no year of birth, but says he was thirteen when he was made a Muslim and twenty-five when he confessed Christ.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 2ης Ιουνίου — «Άγιος Δημήτριος από τη Φιλαδέλφεια Νεομάρτυρας»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 2 Ιουνίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. The page names Philadelphia of Asia Minor as his birthplace and the whole of his story happens there; `locations` is left out all the same, because the corpus does not place a saint the page has not placed to a town. The corpus keeps several men of this name, none of them of Philadelphia: the nearest by day is `demetrius-of-chios`, a different neomartyr. saint.gr prints no hymn for him and links him to the synaxis of the neomartyrs after the fall of Constantinople.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue on pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (1 October 2026).
